skills.name: MVVM structure
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify the UI layer (file.read activities/fragments/composables).
2. Extract state into ViewModel classes (file.write).
3. Expose state via StateFlow/LiveData.
4. Move business logic out of views (file.patch).
5. Build to verify (gradle.exec).

skills.name: MVI unidirectional flow
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define UI state and events as sealed types (file.write).
2. Single reducer function updates state.
3. View renders state; dispatches intents.
4. Keep side effects explicit (events channel).
5. Build and reason about loops.

skills.name: Clean architecture layers
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map current dependencies (file.search imports across layers).
2. Introduce repository interfaces in domain (file.write).
3. Implement data-layer mappers (file.write).
4. Rewire presentation via use cases (file.patch).
5. Build and run tests (gradle.exec).

skills.name: Repository pattern
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define a repository interface per feature (file.write).
2. Implement remote/local data sources behind it.
3. Route all reads/writes through repositories (file.patch call sites).
4. Cache policy lives here only.
5. Test with fakes (gradle.exec).

skills.name: Use case (interactor) pattern
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Extract one business action per class (file.write).
2. Single invoke() with clear params/returns.
3. Compose repositories, not UI logic.
4. Wire into ViewModels (file.patch).
5. Unit test each use case.

skills.name: Manual DI container
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Create an AppContainer class (file.write).
2. Lazily construct singletons there.
3. Pass dependencies into ViewModels via factories.
4. No context leaks: app context only.
5. Build to verify.

skills.name: Hilt basics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search existing Hilt usage to match style.
2. @HiltAndroidApp, @AndroidEntryPoint wiring.
3. @Module/@Provides for third-party types.
4. Scope carefully (@Singleton vs @ViewModelScoped).
5. Build (gradle.exec).

skills.name: Module boundaries
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map package coupling (python.run_file import graph).
2. Propose :core, :feature-* modules (file.write build files).
3. Expose narrow APIs (public interfaces only).
4. Migrate one feature at a time.
5. Build after each (gradle.exec).

skills.name: Interface segregation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Find fat interfaces (file.search for many-method interfaces).
2. Split by consumer needs (file.patch).
3. Update implementations.
4. Remove unused methods.
5. Build + tests.

skills.name: Feature flag architecture
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Central flag provider (file.write).
2. Typed accessors, not raw strings.
3. Defaults in code; overrides via config.
4. Cleanup checklist per flag.
5. Test both paths.

skills.name: Events: bus vs Flow
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Inventory current event usage (file.search EventBus/SharedFlow).
2. Prefer SharedFlow with clear scope.
3. Kill global buses (migrate call sites, file.patch).
4. Test delivery guarantees.
5. Document the decision.

skills.name: Screen vs app state holders
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Classify state: screen-local vs app-wide (file.read).
2. Screen state in ViewModel; app state in a repository-backed holder.
3. Wire via flows only.
4. Remove duplicated caches (file.patch).
5. Build.

skills.name: Image loading with Coil
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search ImageView loads.
2. Use AsyncImage/ImageView extension with models (file.patch).
3. Set crossfade and size hints.
4. Handle placeholders/errors.
5. Verify visually (android_screenshot).

skills.name: Single-activity navigation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map activities to screens (re.apk.manifest of own app).
2. Introduce nav graph (file.write).
3. Route intents via deep links.
4. Migrate one flow at a time (file.patch).
5. Build + UI test (androidopenapp).

skills.name: Background work policy
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Classify each job: deferrable? constrained? (file.read).
2. Deferrable -> WorkManager with constraints.
3. User-facing immediate -> foreground service.
4. Remove ad-hoc threads (file.patch).
5. Verify scheduling in logs.

skills.name: App-wide error strategy
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define error types (file.write): recoverable, fatal, network.
2. Central handler maps to UI states.
3. Log with context (no secrets).
4. Migrate catch sites (file.patch).
5. Test paths.

skills.name: Analytics architecture
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define an analytics facade (file.write).
2. Typed event names/params.
3. Route to providers in one place.
4. Verify events in logs/debug view.
5. Document schema.

skills.name: Remote config pattern
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Facade for config reads (file.write).
2. Defaults for offline.
3. Refresh policy and cache.
4. Feature-gate via config keys.
5. Test fallbacks.

skills.name: Offline-first design
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Local source of truth (Room) (file.write DAO).
2. Sync via WorkManager with backoff.
3. Conflict policy: last-write-wins or merge (document).
4. UI reads local only.
5. Test airplane mode (android_* tools).

skills.name: Caching layer design
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map current caching (file.search cache/okhttp Cache).
2. HTTP cache for network; memory for hot data; DB for durable.
3. TTLs per layer documented (file.write).
4. Invalidate on user actions explicitly.
5. Verify with traffic capture.

skills.name: Test pyramid planning
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Count current tests by type (python.run_file).
2. Push coverage down the pyramid (unit > integration > UI).
3. Convert brittle UI tests to unit (file.write).
4. Track ratio over time.
5. Report.

skills.name: Test naming discipline
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Standard: given/when/then in the name.
2. Rename existing tests (file.patch).
3. Keep one behavior per test.
4. Read like documentation.
5. Run suite.

skills.name: Fixture management
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Builders over literals (file.write factories).
2. Central fixtures folder.
3. Seeded randomness.
4. Cleanup after suites.
5. Document.

skills.name: Integration slices
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Pick a boundary (repo<->db).
2. Write focused integration tests (file.write).
3. Use in-memory deps where possible.
4. Run via gradle.exec.
5. Report.

skills.name: UI test basics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Compose test APIs or Espresso per project (file.list).
2. Test 3 core flows only.
3. Idempotent setup/teardown.
4. Run on emulator via gradle.exec connected task (if device).
5. Report.

skills.name: Screenshot testing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture baseline via web/browser or device (android_screenshot).
2. Compare post-change (python.run_file pixel diff).
3. Flag deltas for review.
4. Store baselines in repo.
5. Document.

skills.name: Flaky test hunting
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Run suite 5x (gradle.exec).
2. Collect failures (python.run_file parse).
3. Fix order/time dependencies.
4. Quarantine unfixable with tickets.
5. Track flake rate.

skills.name: Coverage gap analysis
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Run coverage (gradle.exec jacoco-style task).
2. List low-coverage core classes (python.run_file).
3. Write targeted tests.
4. Re-measure.
5. Report.

skills.name: Mutation testing intro
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. web.search mutation tools for the stack.
2. Run a sample module (process.exec).
3. Review surviving mutants (file.read).
4. Add tests for real gaps.
5. Document.

skills.name: Consumer-contract tests
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define expected request/response per consumer (file.write).
2. Assert against provider stubs.
3. Run in CI.
4. Flag drift loudly.
5. Version contracts.

skills.name: E2E smoke pack
skills.description: Keep a tiny reliable E2E set.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Pick 5 critical journeys (file.write list).
2. Automate each once.
3. Run pre-release only.
4. Fix flake immediately.
5. Report.

skills.name: Test data privacy
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Audit fixtures for real PII (python.run_file patterns).
2. Replace with generators (file.write).
3. Verify no prod dumps in repo.
4. Document policy.
5. Enforce in review.

skills.name: Boundary value testing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List numeric/range boundaries per feature (file.read).
2. Write min/max/±1 cases (file.write).
3. Include zero and negative where valid.
4. Run suite.
5. Report.

skills.name: Property-based testing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify invariants (encode/decode round-trip).
2. Add property tests (python.run_file hypothesis-style or libs).
3. Shrink failures to minimal cases.
4. Fix root causes.
5. Document.

skills.name: Mock boundary rules
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Audit mocks for overuse (file.search mock).
2. Prefer fakes over mocks for state.
3. Mock only I/O edges.
4. Refactor over-mocked tests (file.patch).
5. Run suite.

skills.name: Containerized deps in tests
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Spin DB/broker via containers (process.exec docker).
2. Point tests at them (config).
3. Tear down cleanly.
4. Keep runtimes pinned.
5. Document.

skills.name: Soak testing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Run the app for N hours (device automation).
2. Track memory/objects via dumpsys (process.exec).
3. Flag growth curves (python.run_file).
4. Fix leaks found.
5. Report.

skills.name: Accessibility test passes
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Run a11y scanners on key screens.
2. Fix labels/focus issues (file.patch).
3. Verify with talkback-style reads (androidreadscreen).
4. Track score.
5. Document.

skills.name: Performance test basics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define metrics: startup, jank, memory (file.write).
2. Measure with macrobenchmark-style runs (gradle.exec if configured).
3. Record baselines.
4. Flag regressions in CI.
5. Report.

skills.name: Failure drills
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Kill network/db in the test env (process.exec).
2. Observe recovery behaviors (logs).
3. Fix missing backoff/timeouts.
4. Repeat.
5. Document.
